name: ProductionLine - Default (seed v1)
description: One output of a production structure with its configured rate (production engine P3, #86). Inputs are edited in the web app's line editor or through the API; status and accrual are kept by the engine.

steps.description: What the structure produces and how fast.

fields.label: Production structure
fields.description: The structure that produces it. A line can't move to another structure.

fields.label: Output
fields.description: The item blueprint produced. One line per blueprint and structure.

fields.label: Rate source
fields.description: Configured in P3; Derived and Hybrid come with the yield areas (P4).

fields.label: Rate per hour
fields.description: Units per hour at level multiplier 1 with all workers present (fractions accrue, e.g. 0.3). 0 to 1,000,000.

fields.label: Resource category
fields.description: Overrides the kind's category for weather and category modifiers. Empty = the kind's.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Off pauses the line: no output and no accrual until it is switched on again.
